title: Responsive Layouts with Flexbox & Grid 🧩
description: Combine Flexbox, Grid, and media queries to build truly adaptive interfaces.

slides.title: Putting It All Together 🧱
slides.content:
# Responsive Layout Strategy

1. Start mobile‑first: single column, stacked content.
2. Use Flexbox or Grid for the basic layout.
3. Add `min-width` media queries to change the layout for wider screens.
4. Use relative units and `max-width` to keep content readable.
5. Test on real devices or using DevTools device mode.

This approach creates layouts that flow naturally from the smallest screen to the largest.

quizData.question: What does `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr))` achieve?

options.text: Creates as many columns as fit, each at least 250px, stretching to fill space

quizData.explanation: `auto-fit` fills the row with as many tracks as possible; tracks are at least 250px and grow with `1fr`.

slides.title: Container Queries (The Future) 🔮
Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use `max-width` and Margin Auto for Centred Content

Even in responsive layouts, a centred container with `max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;` prevents content from stretching too wide on ultrawide monitors, preserving readability.
